methods.name: RegisterHqyDomainApiConfiguration
methods.xml_doc: <summary> Register an <seealso cref="Microsoft.Extensions.Options.IOptions{DomainFramework.Client.DomainApiClientConfig}"/> instance with the <paramref name="container"/>. </summary> <param name="container">The Unity container to register the options with.</param> <param name="configurationCustomization">A callback to customize Domain API configuration.</param>

classes.name: BalanceChangeAudit
classes.xml_doc: <summary> Represents an audit record for balance changes in PaymentAccounts. </summary>

methods.name: GetAvailableBalance
methods.xml_doc: <summary> The AccountBalance minus the net overpaid amount (overpaid - recouped) </summary> <returns></returns>

methods.name: GetCurrentYearReimbursementAccountForCarryoverAsync
methods.xml_doc: <summary> Gets the current year ReimbursementAccountsDto for a customer, matching compatible plan type, given the previous year's ReimbursementAccountId. </summary>

methods.name: GetCurrentYearReimbursementAccountDetailsAsync
methods.xml_doc: <summary> Given a previous year's ReimbursementAccountId, fetches the current year's ReimbursementAccountId (with compatible plan type) and the hasDebitcard value from the current year's PaymentPlan. </summary>

methods.name: IsReimbursementAccountCardSuspended
methods.xml_doc: <summary> Determines if the payment plan has debit card configured and if any of the customer dependents card's follow these conditions: <list type="number"> <item>The card's status is suspended</item> <item>The card is set as RA Card</item> <item>The card's date deleted is not set</item> </list> </summary> <param name="ra">Payment Account to check</param> <returns>True if the card is suspended, False otherwise.</returns>

classes.name: ReimbursementAccountRepository_CrossEmployerValidationTests
classes.xml_doc: <summary> Tests to validate that GetCurrentYearReimbursementAccountForCarryoverAsync correctly filters by organization to prevent cross-organization rollover transfers that would cause card balance inflation.  CRITICAL SECURITY REQUIREMENT: This method MUST only return accounts from the SAME organization as the source account. Cross-organization transfers would incorrectly inflate card balances. </summary>
